_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Abby Langdon Alger (1850-1917): Judith Gautier's The Usurper (1884) and, with Frances A. Shaw, the Delsarte System of Oratory (1887); from archive.org, Legouvé, Coquelin, Renan and Saintine (1879-1902). US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 39); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_surname_note: Full name only. 'abby l. alger' is the form on her Ginn and Roberts title pages (2026-10-23).
